notes:
Updating is now one button. Settings > Application shows the new version with an Install button: it downloads, shows the progress, and installs on its own. Jolnova closes and opens again by itself — you never have to download and run the setup file again. If a download was already finished, the button installs it straight away; if something goes wrong it says so and offers to try again.

Everything on that screen, and the update banner at the top, now appears in your own language. Some of it used to stay in English.

If a clip comes out with the wrong area at the top, open it and press "Fix the camera": the 16:9 frame the clip was cut from opens, you drag a box over the streamer's camera, and the clip is rebuilt from the original recording — same resolution, subtitles intact. Jolnova can remember that area for the streamer so new clips come out right. Clips made by older versions are protected too: while their recording is still on disk, the source piece is saved before the recording is cleaned up.

You now decide how every clip goes up. Pressing Publish opens an upload window with the title, the description and who can see it (Private / Unlisted / Public) already filled in. The Sharing page has the same controls, and its calendar now shows your next upload and the month's totals.
